Formulas:
omega = 2πf.
X_L = ω L.
X_C = 1/(ω C).
Z = R + j(X_L - X_C). |Z| = sqrt(R^2 + X^2), X = XL-XC.
I_rms = V_rms / |Z|.
Average power = I_rms^2 R = V^2 R / |Z|^2.
Phase voltage leads current = arctan(X/R) in degrees (positive if inductive XL>XC).
Voltage across inductor = I_rms * XL.
